data.title: This Humanoid Robot Will Clean Your House for $30 an Hour
data.description: San Francisco startup Tau Robotics has launched an invite-only humanoid cleaning service at a flat $30 for a one-hour visit. CEO and co-founder Alexander Koch announced it on X, stating that all footage was shown at 1x speed and that "each humanoid is jointly controlled by a human operator and AI." The robots handle house cleaning, deep cleaning and office cleaning — wiping counters, vacuuming hardwood and rugs, taking out trash and clearing floor clutter.
